title: STOP Programming Your Saab 340 FMS Wrong! (UNS1 Mastery)
description:
The Saab 340 is a masterpiece of analog feel, but most pilots program it wrong. From the infamous "NO LINK" discontinuity to flight plans that simply won’t show on your display, we’re revealing the secrets to mastering the digital brain of this Swedish legend in MSFS 2024.

In Part 5 of our masterclass, we dive into the Universal UNS1 FMS—a system that is tactical and precise but full of old-school quirks. We’re doing a deep dive into the EHSI NAV logic, a live demonstration of why your route might "disappear," and the technical "double-delete" fix for FMS gaps. Don’t fly blind—learn to program the Saab 340 like a pro.

What You’ll Learn in Part 5:

- The Blank Display: Why your flight plan is hidden on the EHSI and how to fix it.
-  The "No Link" Fix: How to clear FMS discontinuities using the double-delete method.
- Sequencing Logic: Why adding your destination too early breaks the UNS1.
- Reverse Planning: A "Misma" method for building routes when the standard way fails.
